elections.notes: First election under the National Front agreement, which gave the Liberals the 1958–62 presidency. Alberto Lleras Camargo was the National Front candidate; Jorge Leyva Urdaneta ran as a dissident Conservative (the table labels his party "Colombian Conservative Party dissidents").

elections.notes: Under the National Front it was the Conservatives' turn. The Electoral Court declared invalid the votes cast for Alfonso López Michelsen (Liberal, 625,630) and Gustavo Rojas Pinilla (National Popular Alliance, 54,562); the table shows them without a share, so they are not listed, and the shares are of the remaining valid votes. Invalid votes (689,258) include them. Both Valencia and Leyva ran as Conservatives.
